# Todo 23A scenario inventory

Source: todo23-properties.md; only the three owned Python files.
This is test selection data, not an expected-output fixture.

## test_product_routing.py (82 tests)

- **PR-1** [contract] End-to-end placement per product and phase: a development defect lands in its team's existing project (`new_issue`, project, `linkState: linked`, nothing under CRW); an in-use defect lands in the triage project with `external_ref` set.
  Tests: test_a_development_defect_lands_in_its_team_and_existing_project, test_an_in_use_defect_lands_in_its_team_and_triage_project
- **PR-2** [behaviour] Control groups: a transient error files nothing; the same incident N times is one fault and one issue (repeats `recorded: false`); distinct causes split and similar wording in two products stays two; a single severe incident is escalated at once (publication + notification).
  Tests: test_a_transient_error_files_no_issue, test_the_same_incident_n_times_is_one_tracking_item, test_distinct_causes_split_and_similar_wording_in_two_products_stays_two, test_a_single_severe_incident_is_escalated_at_once
- **PR-3** [contract] A lost create response makes no duplicate: the publication is `uncertain`, not offered, then `confirmed` from the readback; one issue.
  Tests: test_a_lost_create_response_makes_no_duplicate
- **PR-4** [contract] Completion check against the tracker: a legitimate done is `consistent`, records nothing, writes nothing; a false completion is `mismatch`, comments on the subject's own issue without moving it (`done`, project, no relations/labels), stays in attention until closed, then `resolved` (a later check is a new fault, nothing reopened); a mismatch links its subject (`linked`, attention `completion_mismatch_open`) and leaves attention once resolved; a product policy raising the mismatch threshold keeps the fault `observed` (no comment, attention shown) until it is reached.
  Tests: test_a_legitimate_done_is_kept_and_writes_nothing, test_a_false_completion_stays_flagged_for_reverification_on_its_owner, test_a_completion_mismatch_links_its_subject_and_leaves_attention_once_resolved, test_a_product_policy_that_raises_the_mismatch_threshold_is_honoured_and_visible
- **PR-5** [contract] A mismatch whose subject has no project to be in (no triage), or an open mismatch whose subject leaves every project, is refused `route_state_conflict` before any write (the open one keeps occurrence count, scope and `linked`).
  Tests: test_a_mismatch_on_a_subject_with_no_project_to_be_in_is_refused_before_any_write, test_an_open_mismatch_whose_subject_leaves_every_project_is_refused_not_moved
- **PR-6** [contract] Remediation history: a recurrence behind 25 remediations is found (`accumulate` on ALN-12, state `open`, recurrence `mismatch` naming PR-10); a closure records its own fix after an earlier one (timeline `PR#10, PR#11, suite#12`, `resolved`); a withdrawn claim leaves the open mismatch standing without a new occurrence (acceptance `claim_withdrawn_without_closure`, recorded `standing`, "exception is unverified"), a clean re-check is `consistent` with nothing recorded.
  Tests: test_a_recurrence_is_found_behind_a_long_remediation_history, test_a_closure_records_its_own_fix_after_an_earlier_one, test_a_withdrawn_claim_leaves_an_open_mismatch_standing_without_a_new_occurrence
- **PR-7** [contract] Project proposals: independent fixes sharing a goal create one project once (first `hold: no_project`, all members filed into it); members declaring different criteria make none (skipped "different completion criteria"); a goal that gains other criteria cancels its queued create; a goal that stops qualifying is withdrawn at once; settled proposals are history (listed, not attention); counts alone or no policy create nothing; an existing suitable project is reused; a test project never stands in for a real one.
  Tests: test_a_project_is_created_once_for_independent_fixes_sharing_a_goal, test_members_declaring_different_criteria_for_one_goal_make_no_project, test_a_queued_create_is_cancelled_when_its_goal_gains_other_criteria, test_a_proposal_whose_goal_stops_qualifying_is_withdrawn_at_once, test_settled_proposals_are_history_not_attention, test_counts_alone_or_no_policy_create_nothing, test_an_existing_suitable_project_is_reused, test_a_test_project_never_stands_in_for_a_real_one
- **PR-8** [contract] `project_create` payloads are checked at queue and before issue: a malformed create is refused at queue `fault_observation_malformed`; a create queued on a fault that is not the proposal is never issued ("is not the project proposal routing made"); a malformed pending create is cancelled by a registry change (reason names `payload.members`); a pending create whose members/components are not the goal's is cancelled (claim refused); a project bound after the claim cancels the create ("cancelled").
  Tests: test_a_malformed_project_create_is_refused_when_it_is_queued, test_a_create_queued_on_a_fault_that_is_not_the_proposal_is_never_issued, test_a_malformed_pending_create_is_cancelled_by_a_registry_change, test_a_pending_create_whose_members_or_components_are_not_the_goals_is_cancelled, test_a_project_bound_after_the_claim_cancels_the_create
- **PR-9** [contract] A project create follows its members: a member leaving takes its component out (components `[cache, queue]`, the leaver `held`/`fast_search`); a binding that moves a member re-cuts the create; a re-cut that cannot be queued changes nothing (state and payload kept, retry equal); a member that drops its goal is not left waiting (`held_no_project`, `proposalsUnreached` 1); a goal that qualifies again revives its cancelled create `pending` with the new members.
  Tests: test_a_member_that_leaves_the_goal_takes_its_component_out_of_the_create, test_a_binding_that_moves_a_member_re_cuts_the_goals_create, test_a_re_cut_that_cannot_be_queued_again_leaves_everything_as_it_was, test_a_member_that_drops_its_goal_is_not_left_waiting_on_that_goals_proposal, test_a_goal_that_qualifies_again_revives_its_cancelled_create_with_the_new_members
- **PR-10** [behaviour] Digest paging and proposal rotation: a proposal queued between digest pages defers the holds after it (`proposalsUnreached` 1); a digest that binds a created project reports no `held_no_project` for its members; a settled proposal is not read again; a proposal waiting on its create does not starve a confirmed one.
  Tests: test_a_proposal_queued_between_digest_pages_defers_the_holds_after_it, test_a_digest_that_binds_a_created_project_reports_no_hold_for_its_members, test_a_settled_proposal_is_not_read_again, test_a_proposal_waiting_on_its_create_does_not_starve_a_confirmed_one
- **PR-11** [contract] Project linkage: a create read back in the wrong project is `unlinked` (in attention) and repaired on the same issue, then `linked`; a product with no project files nothing (`no_project`) until one is bound.
  Tests: test_a_create_read_back_in_the_wrong_project_is_repaired_on_the_same_issue, test_a_product_with_no_project_files_nothing_until_one_is_bound
- **PR-12** [contract] Simulated vs observed: a simulated event goes only to the test target (`proj-test`, team TST) and never shares a fault with a real one; a cause counts only incidents of its own origin (a crossed cause is `unverifiedCause`, no count, no obligation).
  Tests: test_a_simulated_event_goes_only_to_the_test_target_and_never_meets_a_real_one, test_a_cause_counts_only_incidents_of_its_own_origin
- **PR-13** [contract] Completion readings are replay-safe: an old reading handed in again after many others, or after the last round closed, is `replayed` and opens no round.
  Tests: test_an_old_reading_handed_in_again_after_many_others_opens_no_round, test_a_replay_is_recognised_even_after_the_last_round_closed
- **PR-14** [contract] Existing items: a completed defect that comes back reopens its own issue (`reopen`, owner, issue `open`, comment there, no new issue); a regression gets a `follow_up` with relation `{type: related, issue}` and the repository label, and reconcile queues nothing more; an owner bound after a create was queued takes the defect (external_ref the owner, comment there).
  Tests: test_a_completed_defect_that_comes_back_reopens_its_own_issue_and_comments_there, test_a_regression_gets_a_follow_up_linked_to_the_fixed_issue_and_its_label, test_an_owner_bound_after_a_create_was_queued_takes_the_defect_instead
- **PR-15** [contract] Shared cause: an unverified cause merges nothing (`new_issue`, `unverifiedCause.faultId`, attention `cause_unverified`) and stands on a filed defect until a verified one links (target `cause`, obligation `toFault`); a linked cause never answers a later unverified one; a binding that places a held defect keeps its unverified cause; a verified cause links the two issues (`related`) and keeps each severity; a cause counts an effect once per episode of the affected defect.
  Tests: test_an_unverified_cause_merges_nothing_and_stands_apart_from_the_defect, test_an_unverified_cause_on_a_filed_defect_stands_until_a_verified_one, test_a_linked_cause_never_answers_a_later_unverified_one, test_a_binding_that_places_a_held_defect_keeps_its_unverified_cause, test_a_verified_cause_links_the_two_records_and_keeps_each_severity, test_a_cause_counts_an_effect_once_per_episode_of_the_affected_defect
- **PR-16** [contract] Unclear ownership: one pending record per workspace is classified and later incidents are forwarded to the `successor`; a classified incident keeps the cause it named; two workspaces never share a pending record.
  Tests: test_one_pending_record_is_classified_and_later_incidents_are_forwarded, test_a_classified_incident_keeps_the_cause_it_named, test_two_workspaces_never_share_a_pending_record
- **PR-17** [contract] Reporting: a nonsense page bound is refused `route_input_malformed` before anything is done (nothing marked `reported`); a second digest with nothing changed is `quiet: true` (first lists `severe`); a capped product does not hide another product's work.
  Tests: test_a_nonsense_page_bound_is_refused_before_anything_is_done, test_a_second_digest_with_nothing_changed_is_quiet, test_a_capped_product_does_not_hide_another_products_work
- **PR-18** [contract] A holder process without the `project_create` kind is never offered it; its claim exits nonzero `fault_kind_unregistered`; a holder with the kind is offered it and the operation payload carries `team`. Go: static registry, so the "without the module" half becomes "kind always registered"; the offer/claim/operation JSON stays exact.
  Tests: test_a_holder_without_the_kind_module_is_never_offered_the_project_create
- **PR-19** [contract] Plan-audit: an owner found after the create was issued is held (`held`/`owner_found_after_create`, attention `held_owner_found_after_create`) without moving the fault's scope.
  Tests: test_an_owner_found_after_the_create_was_issued_is_held_without_moving_the_fault
- **PR-20** [contract] Registry changes: a routed product keeps its workspace (change refused `route_state_conflict`), an unrouted one may move; a new triage project places a held defect (`redecided`); a team change reaches an unwritten create and cancels+requeues an unissued project create ("team is now 'GMX'"); an unissued create waits while its route has no project; a project made in a team the product left is never bound (`held_project_team_changed`); a created project made the test target is held (`held_project_is_test_target`).
  Tests: test_a_routed_product_keeps_its_workspace_and_an_unrouted_one_may_move, test_a_new_triage_project_places_a_defect_held_for_want_of_one, test_a_team_change_reaches_a_create_not_yet_written, test_a_team_change_cancels_a_project_create_not_yet_issued_and_queues_it_again, test_a_create_not_yet_issued_waits_while_its_route_has_no_project, test_a_project_made_in_a_team_the_product_left_is_never_bound_on_faith, test_a_created_project_made_the_test_target_is_held_never_settled_on_it
- **PR-21** [contract] Test target isolation: a product using its test target keeps it (change refused `route_state_conflict`); a test target never shares a project with real work (`route_state_conflict` / `route_input_malformed`); no project takes the `__projects__` scope name (`route_input_malformed`); a simulated completion check leaves real work and a pending project create on their own team (comment only on TST).
  Tests: test_a_product_using_its_test_target_keeps_it, test_a_test_target_never_shares_a_project_with_real_work, test_no_project_takes_the_name_of_the_project_create_scope, test_a_simulated_completion_check_leaves_real_work_on_its_own_team, test_a_simulated_completion_check_leaves_a_pending_project_create_on_its_team
- **PR-22** [behaviour] Decisions are made from reads inside the transaction that records them (decide, evaluate, a project's goals, a binding's registry). Go: assert via a store hook that the read happens on the write transaction.
  Tests: test_every_decision_is_made_inside_the_transaction_that_records_it, test_a_projects_evaluation_reads_its_goals_inside_its_transaction, test_a_binding_is_checked_against_the_registry_it_commits_with
- **PR-23** [contract] A late binding that makes a filed route a follow-up is stored (`follow_up`, `relate`, obligation `toIssue`), and one that undoes it restores `new_issue` with the `add_label` obligation.
  Tests: test_a_late_binding_that_makes_a_filed_route_a_follow_up_is_stored

  Tests: test_an_occurrence_handed_in_again_changes_nothing, test_a_familiar_key_in_a_new_episode_is_new_input
- **PR-25** [behaviour] The ledger port binds on this build and routing's classes and `project_create` kind are registered. Go: covered by the static registry manifest check (todo 22 FLT-2) plus an init test that `completion_mismatch` and `project_create` are present.
  Tests: test_the_port_binds_and_routing_registered_its_classes_and_kind
- **PR-26** [behaviour] A shared-cause occurrence never outlives a filing that failed (count unchanged, no `incident_routes` row).
  Tests: test_a_shared_cause_occurrence_never_outlives_a_filing_that_failed

  Tests: test_the_current_issue_takes_its_runs_failure_and_links_the_symptoms_owner

## test_product_routing_decisions.py (103 tests)

- **PRD-1** [contract] Input validation refuses `route_input_malformed`: an unknown key in a registry record or incident; a product that is not a plain identifier; the pending bucket as a product; an issue ref that is not a Linear identifier; an empty value of the wrong type; NaN/Inf anywhere a scalar is read (finite numbers kept); a named cause's signature is kept verbatim and bounded; evidence is references bounded in count (16), shape and size (4096 bytes).
  Tests: test_a_registry_record_with_a_key_nobody_defined_is_refused, test_an_incident_with_a_key_nobody_defined_is_refused_rather_than_kept, test_a_product_is_a_plain_identifier, test_the_pending_bucket_cannot_be_registered_as_a_product, test_an_issue_ref_that_is_not_a_linear_identifier_is_refused, test_an_empty_value_of_the_wrong_type_is_refused_not_read_as_missing, test_numbers_without_json_text_are_refused_everywhere_a_scalar_is_read, test_a_named_causes_signature_is_identity_bounded_and_never_rewritten, test_evidence_is_references_bounded_in_count_shape_and_size
  Rows: product `alpha/notes` | `alpha:notes` | `alpha@notes` | `alpha|notes`; scalar nan | inf | -inf
- **PRD-2** [contract] A routing policy that would create projects from counts alone, or lacks its `basis`, is refused (`route_input_malformed`, CLI exit 2); with a basis it is stored.
  Tests: test_a_policy_that_would_create_projects_from_counts_alone_is_refused, test_a_policy_without_its_basis_is_refused
- **PRD-3** [contract] A follow-up names the checks it took over (`followUpOf: [{issue, checks}]`), else refused.
  Tests: test_a_follow_up_names_the_checks_it_took_over
- **PRD-4** [contract] Coverage lists every surface (`dev_run`, `verification`, `user_report`, `real_use`) with `state` `watched` or `unobserved`, reason `declared and switched off`, `method` null when unconnected.
  Tests: test_every_surface_is_listed_and_an_unconnected_one_reads_unobserved
- **PRD-5** [contract] Product resolution: a declared registered product wins; a declared unregistered one resolves to nothing; a repository one product claims names it, several resolve to nothing; a defect seen in a CRW run is filed under the product, not CRW; a declared product whose repository another claims waits (reason names the other).
  Tests: test_a_declared_registered_product_wins, test_a_declared_unregistered_product_resolves_to_nothing, test_a_repository_one_product_claims_names_that_product, test_a_repository_several_products_claim_resolves_to_nothing, test_a_defect_seen_in_a_crw_run_is_not_filed_under_crw, test_a_declared_product_whose_repository_another_product_claims_waits
- **PRD-6** [contract] Workspace: a resolved product files in its own workspace; an incident claiming another workspace for a product is refused; an unresolved one keeps its workspace or `unassigned`; two workspaces share a pending signature but not a workspace.
  Tests: test_a_resolved_product_files_in_its_own_workspace, test_an_incident_claiming_another_workspace_for_a_product_is_refused, test_an_unresolved_incident_keeps_its_workspace_or_the_sentinel, test_two_workspaces_give_two_pending_identities
- **PRD-7** [contract] `decide()` disposition table (pure).
  Tests: test_the_current_issue_takes_evidence_from_its_own_run, test_a_run_recorded_for_another_issue_attaches_nothing, test_a_run_this_store_does_not_know_attaches_nothing, test_a_user_report_is_never_attached_to_a_current_issue, test_a_symptom_another_open_issue_owns_goes_there_even_with_a_current_issue, test_a_shared_component_alone_never_merges_two_defects, test_several_open_owners_are_held_rather_than_one_chosen, test_the_same_defect_after_completion_reopens_its_issue, test_a_regression_of_a_fix_is_a_follow_up_linked_to_the_fixed_issue, test_a_regression_naming_no_known_fix_links_nothing, test_several_covering_projects_are_decided_by_goal_or_held, test_no_covering_project_uses_triage_else_holds, test_an_owner_without_a_project_is_held_when_there_is_no_triage, test_an_expected_state_is_observed_and_never_filed, test_the_current_issue_comes_first_and_is_linked_to_a_same_symptom_owner, test_several_covering_projects_are_held_even_with_a_triage_project
  Rows: own run -> `attach_current` ALN-3 proj-aln-editor | run of another issue -> `new_issue` ("belongs to ALN-4") | unknown run -> `new_issue` | user report -> `new_issue` | symptom owned elsewhere -> `accumulate` ALN-7 | shared component only -> `new_issue`, owner null | several owners -> `held`/`ambiguous_owner` | same defect after done -> `reopen` ALN-9 | regression of fix -> `follow_up` relate [ALN-9] | regression, unknown fix -> `new_issue` relate [] | several projects + goal -> that project; no goal -> `held`/`ambiguous_project` (also with triage) | none covering -> triage, else `no_project` | owner without project, no triage -> `owner_project_missing` | expected state -> `observe`/stage `observed` | current issue + same-symptom owner -> `attach_current` relate [ALN-12]; without current -> `accumulate`

- **PRD-11** [contract] Completion evaluation per check (acceptance, install, handoff).
  Tests: test_a_legitimate_done_is_consistent_and_asks_for_nothing, test_deployment_is_never_assumed_mandatory, test_a_requirement_is_a_boolean_and_a_null_check_reads_missing, test_done_without_acceptance_evidence_is_a_mismatch, test_merged_without_a_required_install_result_is_a_mismatch, test_an_ended_session_without_its_handoff_is_a_mismatch, test_unobservable_and_unknown_are_unverified_rather_than_guessed, test_nothing_claimed_is_not_applicable, test_a_requirement_dropped_after_a_mismatch_leaves_the_mismatch_open, test_an_approved_scope_reduction_is_an_exception, test_a_scope_reduction_nobody_approved_is_unverified, test_a_follow_up_counts_only_for_the_check_it_took_over, test_an_exception_claimed_on_a_check_that_passed_does_not_flag_a_legitimate_done, test_an_unverified_exception_on_an_unobservable_check_leaves_it_unverified
  Rows: legitimate done -> `consistent`, recurrences [] | install not required -> `consistent` | requirement 0/1/0.0 -> refused; null -> `unknown`/`unobservable` | done, acceptance absent/failed -> `mismatch` | merged, install required, none -> `mismatch` | ended session, no handoff -> `mismatch` | unobservable/unknown -> `unverified` | nothing claimed -> all `not_applicable` | requirement dropped after mismatch -> `requirement_changed_without_approval`, overall `mismatch` | approved reduction -> `excepted`, `consistent` | unapproved -> `exception_unverified`, `mismatch` | follow-up only for its check (ALN-20 `excepted`; ALN-21/22/23/9/77 `exception_unverified`) | exception on passed check -> `consistent` | unverified exception on unobservable -> `unverified`

- **PRD-17** [contract] A classification names a product and who made it (`product`, `goal: {key, criteria}`); a malformed one is refused; classifying into a product that does not watch the surface is refused `route_surface_unwatched` with nothing written.
  Tests: test_a_classification_names_a_product_and_who_made_it, test_classifying_into_a_product_that_does_not_watch_the_surface_is_refused
- **PRD-18** [contract] Route rows: a route keeps its newest `MAX_STORED_INCIDENTS` (16) incidents and its highest claimed severity; listing pages by a stable cursor (`next` null at end); a target nobody wrote is refused; a goal is replaced when written and kept when not.
  Tests: test_a_route_keeps_its_newest_incidents_and_its_highest_claimed_severity, test_listing_pages_by_a_stable_cursor, test_a_target_nobody_wrote_is_refused_rather_than_guessed, test_a_goal_is_replaced_when_written_and_kept_when_not
- **PRD-19** [contract] One attention name per waiting state: pending -> `awaiting_classification`; held -> `held_<hold>`; unlinked -> `link_incomplete` (outranks a standing cause claim); open mismatch -> `completion_mismatch_open` (null once resolved); unbound observed proposal -> `project_proposed`; standing unverified cause -> `cause_unverified`; otherwise null.
  Tests: test_one_decision_name_per_waiting_state, test_a_standing_cause_claim_never_hides_a_missing_project_link
- **PRD-20** [contract] `project_create` eligibility (the pre-issue predicate, from store rows): no enabled policy creates nothing; a create for the product's old team is refused ("alpha-notes's team is now 'ALX', not 'ALN'"); the payload is checked whatever JSON it is; members count only as this product's routes and components are theirs ("the create covers [...]", "N held defect(s)"); members declaring other criteria do not count; a member that left cancels; a project bound meanwhile covering a member cancels; a project readback must show the team it was made in.
  Tests: test_no_enabled_policy_creates_nothing, test_a_create_queued_for_the_products_old_team_is_refused, test_a_project_create_payload_is_checked_whatever_json_it_is, test_members_count_only_as_this_products_routes_and_components_are_theirs, test_members_that_declare_other_criteria_for_the_goal_do_not_count, test_a_member_that_left_the_group_cancels_the_create, test_a_project_bound_meanwhile_that_covers_a_member_cancels_the_create, test_a_project_readback_must_show_the_team_it_was_made_in
  Rows (payload): None | [] | "payload" | 3 | good with each field changed
- **PRD-21** [behaviour] Reconcile and replay detection read past the first page: reconcile reads 120 routes in 3 pages; a reading a closed round recorded is recognised when handed in again even past `MAX_STORED_INCIDENTS`.
  Tests: test_reconcile_reaches_past_its_first_page, test_a_reading_a_closed_round_recorded_is_recognised_when_handed_in_again
- **PRD-22** [behaviour] Proposal rotation: each check moves a proposal to the back so every one is reached; what is not reached is counted exactly and without a cap (`unreached_count`, `unreached_proposal` per product).
  Tests: test_each_check_moves_a_proposal_to_the_back_so_every_one_is_reached, test_what_is_not_reached_is_answered_exactly_and_without_a_cap

## test_project_completion.py (17 tests)

Owned here for `completion-check`/`linkage-completion`; the plan lists test_project_completion.py under todo 26 as well - one of the two ledgers should drop it.

- **PC-0** [python-internal] The locally spelled project scope constant equals linkage's (import-ring drift guard). Not ported: Go shares one constant.
  Tests: test_the_local_project_constant_equals_the_linkage_one
- **PC-1** [contract] No answer is never completion: without a reader, or a store that raises, `state: unreadable`, `readable: false`, `outstanding: []`, `basis` names why ("could not be enumerated" / the error); no attached assignment is `unregistered` (`readable: true`); two live owners are `ambiguous` with `competingOwners` sorted.
  Tests: test_without_a_reader_it_says_it_cannot_answer, test_a_store_that_raises_is_unreadable_and_names_the_fault, test_no_attached_assignment_is_unregistered_not_finished, test_two_live_owners_are_ambiguous_and_not_resolved
- **PC-2** [contract] Completion needs every child of the project's set: one unfinished assignment keeps it `incomplete` (`unfinished[].relationshipId`, `state`); partial done cannot close it; work parked on another parent still counts; everything finished is `complete_candidate`, never `complete`, with `limits` stating "not a completion verdict" and "goal status is never consulted".
  Tests: test_one_unfinished_assignment_keeps_the_project_incomplete, test_partial_done_cannot_close_the_parent, test_work_parked_on_another_parent_still_counts, test_everything_finished_is_a_candidate_and_never_complete
- **PC-3** [contract] Read failures are classified: owners unreadable -> `unreadable` ("scope_bindings unreadable"); expanding the unfinished set fails -> `unreadable` ("relationships unreadable"); ambiguity is established from owners alone and not masked by a failing state read; an unattached project is `unregistered` even when state would fail.
  Tests: test_a_failure_reading_owners_is_unreadable_not_an_exception, test_a_failure_expanding_the_unfinished_set_is_unreadable, test_ambiguity_is_not_masked_by_a_failing_assignment_read, test_an_unattached_project_is_still_unregistered_when_state_would_fail
- **PC-4** [contract] `linkage-completion --project` is an offline command that surfaces the reading unchanged (never `complete`) and passes `unreadable` through. Go: `Domain/cli-shape` for the registration half.
  Tests: test_the_offline_command_list_names_it, test_the_command_is_registered_with_a_project_argument, test_the_command_surfaces_the_reading_and_never_says_complete, test_the_command_passes_the_unreadable_answer_through
